attempts.summary: Built a 3-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster (node1, node2, node3) on RHEL 9 via systemd units with static bootstrap, opened firewalld ports 2379/2380. Verified cross-node read/write replication, tolerance of a single-member outage with continued reads/writes, and catch-up sync of the returning member. Completed the mandatory sequential restart protocol on all three nodes: captured boot_id + etcd health baseline, issued native `reboot`, polled until reachable again, confirmed changed boot_id, and verified etcd auto-restarted with full cluster/raft sync before proceeding to the next node.
